description: This file is a shell script that defines service handler functions for the 'byoi' service. It manages network modes, IP address changes, and other events related to the 'byoi' service in a network device setting, including starting, stopping, and handling IP address and mode changes.

methods.name: service_init
methods.description: Initializes service configuration by retrieving syscfg and sysevent parameters.

methods.name: service_start
methods.description: Starts the service, sets status, validates configuration, and prepares the service for operation.

methods.name: service_stop
methods.description: Stops the service, cleans up, and updates status.

methods.name: handle_bridge_ipv4_ipaddr_change
methods.description: Handles changes in bridge IPv4 address, switching modes based on IP privacy status.

methods.name: handle_current_wan_ipaddr_change
methods.description: Handles WAN IP address changes, managing bridge modes and DHCP proxy accordingly.

methods.name: handle_current_hsd_mode
methods.description: Handles changes in the current HSD mode, triggering reconfiguration if necessary.
